title: Compare Calibration Runs
text:
Select any set of calibration runs to compare their headline validation metrics side by side. Data comes from each run’s summary_metrics_*.json (one per stage, written by that stage’s .qmd at render time — see report/README.md), not from re-reading raw model output, so this page stays fast regardless of how many calibration runs accumulate.






data = transpose(compare_data)
runsAvailable = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.calib_run))).sort()
stagesAvailable = Array.from(new Set(data.map(d => d.stage))).sort()























CompareData Table



viewof selectedRuns = Inputs.checkbox(runsAvailable, {
  label: "Calibration Runs:",
  value: runsAvailable
})

viewof selectedStage = Inputs.select(stagesAvailable, {
  label: "Stage:",
  value: stagesAvailable[0]
})
















filtered = data.filter(d =>
  selectedRuns.includes(d.calib_run) && d.stage === selectedStage
)

metricsInStage = Array.from(new Set(filtered.map(d => d.metric)))
















filtered.length
  ? Plot.plot({
      grid: true,
      height: Math.max(260, metricsInStage.length * 220),
      marginLeft: 70,
      fy: { label: null, domain: metricsInStage },
      x: { label: "Calibration Run" },
      y: { label: "Value" },
      color: { legend: true, label: "Calibration Run" },
      marks: [
        Plot.barY(filtered, {
          x: "calib_run",
          y: "value",
          fy: "metric",
          fill: "calib_run",
          tip: true
        }),
        Plot.ruleY([0])
      ]
    })
  : html`<p><em>No calibration runs have a summary_metrics_*.json for stage "${selectedStage}" yet.</em></p>`








Figure 1: Headline metrics by calibration run







Inputs.table(filtered, {
  columns: ["calib_run", "stage", "metric", "value"],
  header: { calib_run: "Run", stage: "Stage", metric: "Metric", value: "Value" },
  sort: "calib_run",
  rows: 20
})

crtRunsAvailable = Array.from(new Set(transpose(crt_model_data).map(d => d.calib_run))).sort()

viewof crtCalibRunSelect = Inputs.select(crtRunsAvailable, {
  value: crtRunsAvailable[crtRunsAvailable.length - 1],
  label: "Calibration Run"
});
viewof modeInput = Inputs.select(["Drive", "Walk"], {label: "Access Mode", value: "Drive"});
viewof metricInput = Inputs.select(["Access Distance (mi)", "Access Time (min)"], {label: "Metric", value: "Access Distance (mi)"});
viewof layersInput = Inputs.checkbox(["Observed", "Modeled"], {label: "Show Data:", value: ["Observed", "Modeled"]});





































dataObs = transpose(crt_plot_data)
dataMod = transpose(crt_model_data).filter(d => d.calib_run === crtCalibRunSelect)

// 2. Reactive Filtering
metricInfo = metricInput === "Access Distance (mi)"
  ? { col: "access_dist", label: "Distance (miles)", max: 10 }
  : { col: "access_time", label: "Time (minutes)", max: 30 };

filteredObs = dataObs.filter(d => d.Ac_Mode2_Model === modeInput);
filteredMod = dataMod.filter(d => d.Ac_Mode2_Model === modeInput);

// Calculate dynamic max domain
domainMax = Math.max(
  d3.max(filteredObs, d => d[metricInfo.col]) || 0,
  d3.max(filteredMod, d => d[metricInfo.col]) || 0
) * 1.05;

// 3. Render Merged Plot
Plot.plot({
  height: 900,
  marginLeft: 160,
  marginTop: 40,
  style: { fontFamily: "Inter, sans-serif", fontSize: "13px", color: "#374151" },

  x: {
    label: metricInfo.label,
    labelOffset: 40,
    domain: [0, domainMax],
    grid: true,
    tickSize: 0,
    line: true
  },

  fy: {
    label: null,
    domain: station_list,
    padding: 0.1,
    tickFormat: d => d.replace(" Station", "")
  },

  y: {
    axis: "right",          // Move axis to the right side
    label: "Weighted Count", // Label what the height represents
    grid: true,             // Add horizontal grid lines to help compare peaks
    tickFormat: "s"         // Short format (e.g., 200, 1.5k) to save space
  },

  color: {
    domain: ["Observed", "Modeled"],
    range: ["#77933c", "#376092"],
    legend: true
  },

  marks: [
    // --- MODELED LAYER (Blue) ---
    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.areaY(filteredMod, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        fill: "#376092",
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        sort: { fy: null }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.lineY(filteredMod, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        stroke: "#376092",
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    )) : null,

    // --- OBSERVED LAYER (Green) ---
    layersInput.includes("Observed") ? Plot.areaY(filteredObs, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        fill: "#77933c",
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        sort: { fy: null }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Observed") ? Plot.lineY(filteredObs, Plot.binX(
      { y: "sum" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        thresholds: 50,
        curve: "basis",
        stroke: "#77933c",
        strokeWidth: 1.5
      }
    )) : null,

    // --- SHARED BASELINE ---
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "#e5e7eb", strokeWidth: 1 }),

    // --- MEDIANS ---
    layersInput.includes("Modeled") ? Plot.ruleX(filteredMod, Plot.groupZ(
      { x: "median" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        stroke: "#376092",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "4,2",
        tip: {
          format: {
            x: (d) => `Median: ${d.toFixed(2)} ${metricInput.includes("Time") ? "min" : "mi"}`,
            fy: false,
            weight: false
          },
          fill: "white",
          stroke: "#374151",
          anchor: "bottom"
      }
      }
    )) : null,

    layersInput.includes("Observed") ? Plot.ruleX(filteredObs, Plot.groupZ(
      { x: "median" },
      {
        x: metricInfo.col,
        fy: "Stop_Name",
        weight: "boarding_weight",
        stroke: "#77933c",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeDasharray: "4,2",
        tip: {
          format: {
            x: (d) => `Median: ${d.toFixed(2)} ${metricInput.includes("Time") ? "min" : "mi"}`,
            fy: false,
            weight: false
          },
          fill: "white",
          stroke: "#374151",
          anchor: "bottom"
      }
      }
    )) : null
  ]
})
